summary: Harden the PH-244 verify_integrity bank-fee saved-event checks: each BankCharge must have exactly one costing.bank_charge_saved.v1 event per version (1..version), each event must be a complete envelope for its own version (source=costing/bank_charge stable ref, source.version, topic/schema_version, changed_refs=[that version ref], posting_event_refs=[]), and missing/duplicated/old-version/tampered history is corruption. The branch now accepts the canonical five statuses: draft/pending/rejected/superseded must carry no cost facts, while approved may be the PH-250 transitional state without cost facts or must carry exactly one complete cost fact set (one SourceConsumption claim consumer=cost coverage_key=bank_charge:<id> amount=gross, one AccountingEvent event_type=costing.bank_charge.cost effect=gross with frozen occurred_on/posting_period, one LedgerPosting book=cost origin=current scope=project amount=gross); duplicates, missing postings, amount mismatches, orphan cost events and stray fee claims are reported. The labor event loop allowlists the PH-250 costing/bank_charge cost event so it is validated only by the fee branch. No canonical contract, PH-244 service/model or migration change.
